mentions.name: ApostropheCMS Postgres and SQLite support
mentions.description: ApostropheCMS is gaining Postgres and SQLite database support alongside its existing MongoDB API. The work is being done as a series of personal weekend projects using Claude Code AI agents, treating it as an adapter-pattern problem validated against a large multi-level test suite, with the feature targeted to land in May.
mentions.problem: ApostropheCMS was heavily committed to the MongoDB API, which it exposes as part of its own API, making support for other databases unrealistic before AI coding agents.
